# Uptime

Get the uptime of target hosts.

## Where it is served

| Surface | Where |
| ------- | ----- |
| API | `/api/node/{hostname}/uptime`, in [API](/category/api) |
| CLI | `osapi client node uptime` |
| Jobs | `behavior.uptime.<method>`, run by the agent |

## Built on

| Uses | Used by |
| ---- | ------- |
| Nothing | Nothing |

## Where it runs

On `linux`, `darwin`. On any other platform its methods report `skipped`.

On darwin it also runs `sysctl`.

In a trace, a call is the span `behavior.uptime.<method>`, with `exec sysctl` under it.

## Methods

| Method | Verb | Permission | Description |
| ------ | ---- | ---------- | ----------- |
| [`get`](../../usage/cli/client/node/uptime/get.md) | read | `uptime:read` | Get the uptime of the host |

## Settings

None. A behavior declares settings with `behavior.Config`.

## Inspecting it

```bash
osapi behavior get --name uptime                           # surfaces, methods, types, settings, telemetry
osapi behavior method get --name uptime --method <method>  # one method, with its JSON Schema
```
